summary: Keep native stui terminals on the daemon's ordered shared geometry to avoid stale or duplicated rows during resize

replay.detail: No stored event replay changes. Native terminal attachment now parses each snapshot using the geometry preceding it on the wire, without applying read-ahead geometry.

schema.detail: No database schema or replicated claim change.

rules.detail: Pane resize requests no longer resize the local emulators ahead of queued output. Only daemon GEOMETRY frames change effective dimensions. Kitty cell-metric frames retain the pane's requested dimensions, not another writer's constrained effective grid.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing pinned PTY GEOMETRY protocol; no wire change. Pinned 063ff7f broadcasts every effective resize before kernel resize and sends geometry before initial replay even when unchanged. Pre-GEOMETRY legacy daemons are unsupported for native resize; see docs/stui-terminal-tab.md for source evidence and why speculative fallback is unsafe.

downtime.detail: No pinned daemon restart is required for this client-only change; reopen stui to use the updated viewer.

manual.detail: No migration is required. Pre-GEOMETRY legacy daemons must be replaced before native terminal resize is supported.
